sections.body:
[db=live]Welcome to the Destruction Warlock rotation guide for Midnight Season 2! This guide will teach you all about the optimal rotation for Destruction Warlock across its various talent builds. It will cover both core ability cadence and cooldown usage in dungeons and raids for [b]Midnight Season 2[/b].
[pad]

sections.heading: How to Play Destruction
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Destruction"][color=c9]Destruction Warlock Rotation in The War Within[/color][/h2]

Destruction excels at dealing large hits through [spell=116858] and very strong cleave damage through [spell=80240]. Destruction is by nature a relatively simple spec to play, but with a different [resource=7] system than Affliction and Demonology, the playstyle is quite different.
When playing Destruction, your rotation includes:

[wrapper width=80%][box border=true]
[center]
[table style=grid][tr][td]
	[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=5%][icon name=inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02 size=medium type=round color=c9 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=warlock]Soul Shard management[/color][/b] Do not overcap Soul Shards. Destruction's Soul Shards resource is different than Affliction and Demonology, as all our shards are split into 10 soul shard fragments. We have great control over generating and spending this resource, so make sure you're aware of having  Soul Shards when you need them, while not wasting any Soul Shards by overcapping.[/td]
	[/tr]
	[/table]
[hr]
	[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=5%][icon name=ability_warlock_baneofhavoc size=medium type=round color=c9 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=warlock]Cooldown management:[/color][/b]Being able to properly manage your cooldowns, such as [spell=80240] and [spell=1122] will make a big difference in how much damage you're doing. Making sure you have the correct amount of Soul Shards before using these, and making sure you don't lose out on any uses, is a big difference maker between high DPS and low DPS.[/td]
	[/tr]
	[/table]
[hr]
	[table]
	[tr][td width=5%][icon name=ability_rogue_sprint size=medium type=round color=c9 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=warlock]Movement:[/color][/b] When you're moving around, you only have very few ways to deal damage. You can play around with always casting abilities such as [spell=17962] while running, but odds are you're going to lose out on DPS. That means, playing movement segments correctly will be a big difference maker. Utilizing abilities like [spell=48018] and [spell=111771] properly will help you with that.[/td]
	[/tr]
	[/table]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[/center]
[/box]
[/wrapper]


[center][wrapper width=800px][box border=true]If you're looking for a more bite-sized rotation explanation, check out our simplified guide below:

[center][cta-button=guide=33013 icon=spell_shadow_rainoffire]Destruction Warlock Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center][/box][/wrapper][/center]

[h2 toc=false type=bar]Pre-Combat Check[/h2]
	Before any combat happens, it is important for Destruction Warlock to make sure the following are done. This applies to raids, dungeons, delves, or even open-world content.
	[center][wrapper width=800px][center][box]
	[ul]
		[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Get your food buff and oil applied![/b][/li]
		[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Summon your Pet![/b][/li]		
		[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Drop healthstones! -[/b] Cast [spell=29893] for every party/raid member to get a [item=5512][/li]
		[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Portals, portals everywhere! -[/b] As needed, make sure your portals are down in an appropriate location. This includes both personal, [spell=268358] and group, [spell=111771] portals.[/li]
		[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Double Check your Talents! -[/b] Have another quick look to make sure you are in the correct talents for the boss, and you can't see any changes that might help.[/li]
	[/ul]

sections.heading: Rotation Assist
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Rotation Assist" type=bar][icon name=ui_spellbook_onebutton color=c9 inline=true size=medium type=round][/icon][color=c9] Single Button Rotation Assistant Losses for Destruction Warlock [/color][/h2]
Destruction has a relatively simple rotation that works by generating Soul Shards and spending that resource on damage-dealing spells. Compared to other DPS specs, we have a lower number of main abilities in our rotation. For this reason, the rotational tool might not actually be that horrible percentagewise compared to a lot of other specs. That being said, using the rotational tool is not going to be the way you get the most out of your character, but for a casual player just running through non challenging content you will be able to get away with using it.

[h3 toc="DPS Loss"]Rotation Assist Losses for Destruction Warlock[/h3]
When using the Rotation Assist, you can expect the following losses when compared to performing your rotation yourself:

[b]Single Target[/b]
[ul]
[li]Assisted Highlight: About [b]~3.8% DPS Loss[/b][/li]
[li]Single-Button Assistant: About [b]~10.4% DPS Loss[/b][/li]
[/ul]

[b]Note - [/b] These numbers assume the player manually casts [spell=1122], which is not being highlighted by neither the rotation assist or the single-button helper. If you do not manually remember to use [spell=1122], your DPS loss is going to be significantly higher.

[b]AoE[/b]
[ul]
[li]Assisted Highlight: About [b]~11% DPS Loss[/b][/li]
[li]Single-Button Assistant: About [b]~14% DPS Loss[/b][/li]
[/ul]

[b]Note - [/b] For AoE it's a little hard deciding what to expect. It's going to vary heavily on wether or not you manually pop your [spell=1122] and [spell=80240], because the helper does not do this. The numbers above assume neither of these are manually popped on AoE, so if you do manually pop them regardless you can expect a lower DPS loss.

[h3 toc="Cooldowns Not Used"]Destruction Warlock Cooldowns Not Used by Rotation Assist[/h3]
When using both the assisted highlighting and the single-button assistant, you will need to use the following cooldowns manually, because they will not automatically be used by the one-button assistant. Both of these cooldowns are important for the Destruction DPS output, and if they're not used at all the expected DPS loss is going to be significantly worse than the numbers presented above. For more information on how to properly use these cooldowns, there is a segment further down in this guide explaining more in depth.

[toggler id=cdlist toc=false hidden]Click to expand list of cooldowns[/toggler]
[div id=cdlist hidden]
[ul]
[li][spell=1122][/li]
[li][spell=80240][/li]
[/ul]
[/div][pad]

A way to combat this slightly is opting to pick up [spell=387506] rather than [spell=80240]. While [spell=80240] might be a better option a lot of the time, [spell=387506] is much better than having [spell=80240] and not using it.

The [url=https://www.wowhead.com/guide/ui/combat-assistant-one-button-rotation-tool-setup]Rotation Assist[/url] is a new tool added in Patch 11.1.7. To learn more about it, check our guide below.[br][pad][center][cta-button=https://www.wowhead.com/guide/ui/combat-assistant-one-button-rotation-tool-setup]Rotation Assist Overview[/cta-button][/center]

sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][icon name=spell_shadow_summoninfernal color=c9 inline=true size=medium type=round][/icon] [color=c9]Destruction Warlock Major Cooldown Usage[/color][/h2]
[pad]
Destruction has a number of both big and small cooldowns that are important to know how to play in order to succeed.

[tabs name="cds"]
[tab name="Summon Infernal" icon=spell_shadow_summoninfernal]
[spell=1122] is our 2-minute cooldown that helps us generate more Soul Shards during its duration. Some things to keep in mind when using your infernal is:
[ul]
[li]If you're playing [spell=417234], your Infernal cast also makes your damage more important. It's not only a point and click cooldown that does damage on its own; make sure you pair this up with any racial ability and trinkets if you can.[/li]
[li]Keep in mind you can delay this cooldown as long as you don't miss out on uses. During a Mythic+ dungeon you will likely want to pop this as often as possible because you will lose out on uses otherwise, but popping it at the correct time is important.[/li]
[/ul]


[/tab]
[tab name="Havoc" icon=ability_warlock_baneofhavoc]
I have already covered [spell=80240] very thoroughly in this guide, but I will just recap the important points here:
[ul]
[li]Keep in mind you can generate 2x Soul Shards with [spell=80240] while your spenders don't cost extra.[/li]
[li][spell=80240] only replicates 60% of the damage of your single-target abilities, meaning you should apply this to the less important target.[/li]
[li]Make sure your target is going to live for the full [spell=80240] duration if possible.[/li]
[/ul]

[/tab]
[tab name="Diabolist Demons" icon=ability_bossfellord_felspike]
When playing [symbol=wow-hero-talent-diabolist] [color=c3]Diabolist[/color] Destruction, you can gain a good portion of damage by knowing what each of the demons summoned by the hero talent tree does:

Because of the talent [spell=429893], and because of how [symbol=wow-hero-talent-diabolist] [color=c3]Diabolist[/color] Destruction works, you want to trigger your demons by casting a [spell=116858]. This is unless you're in a situation where you're damaging a LOT of targets, and in that situation you should probably be playing [symbol=wow-hero-talent-hellcaller] [color=necrolord]Hellcaller[/color].
[ul]
[li][spell=428524] - Charges your target and does a frontal cleave. Enemies hit by this cleave then takes increased damage from you and your demons because of the talent [spell=428517]. If the target you cast on to trigger the [spell=428524] dies before the overlord reaches the target, it instead swaps to a different target and hits that one. Keep this in mind, because if you're damaging a lot of targets, try not to trigger this onto a target that is standing alone. Try to aim this into a big pack for the most damage. Also, keep in mind your damage is increased to targets hit by this for 15 seconds, so try to hit those targets.[/li]
[li][spell=432794] - Summons next to you and starts channelling damage into your target. Additionally, triggering this demonic art changes your next [spell=29722] into [spell=434506] which deals increased damage and generates 2 full Soul Shards. Make sure you do not overcap on Soul Shards by casting this. Instead, cast [spell=116858] to go down to at least 2,5 Soul Shards, but ideally below 2 Soul Shards before casting [spell=434506]. Also, the abilitiy [spell=432794] casts when summoned is a channelled AoE, which might not always start rechannelling onto a new target if the target dies during this channel. For that reason, try to cast this onto a target that's going to live for the full duration.[/li]
[li][spell=432795] - Is also summoned right next to you, and starts dealing pulsating AoE damage onto and around your target. Additionally, triggering this Demonic Art turns your next [spell=116858] into [spell=434635]. A very powerful AoE around your target. Make sure you cast this on the mob where it's going to hit the most targets possible.[/li]
[/ul]
[pad]
Some extra notes when palying Diabolist is, that you always cycle in the same order. It goes:
[ol]
[li]Overlord[/li]
[li]Mother of Chaos[/li]
[li]Pit Lord[/li]
[/ol]
This resets on boss combat in raids, but not in dungeons. This means, you can play slower or faster from time to time, depending on what demon you want to summon. As an example, if you're in a dungeon and you're about to finish off a pack, just killing off the last few mobs, and you're about to gain [spell=432795], do not trigger this on that pack. Instead, be a little patient and deal big damage on the next pack. Do not postpone this, because when playing, you do cycle through the rotation of demons fairly quickly. However, it adds a layer of complexity and depth to the playstyle and might ultimately make your damage output significantly higher.
[/tab]
[tab name="Malevolence" icon=inv_ability_hellcallerwarlock_malevolence]
Before pressing [spell=442726], always have all of your [spell=445468] applied. This can happen by you doing a big pull, casting [spell=152108] -> [spell=196447] and then following it up by [spell=442726] into either [spell=116858] or [spell=5740] spam, collapsing your [spell=445468] stacks, dealing damage with [spell=440043]. 

During [spell=442726], all of the [resource=7] you cast grants double stacks of [spell=445468] to your targets, so try your very best to have some shards ready before, and make sure you dump as much as you can before [spell=442726] runs out. And be careful not to let your [spell=445468] drop on high stacks.
[/tab]

[/tabs]


[tooltip name=AoEspender][color=q]On 1-3 targets, spend Soul Shards on [spell=116858]. On 4+ use [spell=5740]. When moving and about to cap on Soul Shards, cast [spell=17877].[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=rancora][color=q]This is when you're about to proc your Diabolist demon. You want to use a [spell=116858] to do so to benefit from the increased damage, as well as the reduced cast time.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=STspender][color=q]Make sure you read the section below on what soul shard spender you should use in what situation. This is for single-target, so [spell=116858] is the best bet, but in general, make sure you're aware of what soul-shard spender you should use in what situation.[/color][/tooltip]
